text: Pursuant to Section 170(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, the Ombudsman has concluded the report about its Investigation into Toronto Community Housing Corporation's Tenant Human Rights Complaints Process. We hereby table with City Council for its June 14, 2023 session the Investigation Report, dated June 9, 2023.
City Council on July 19 and 20, 2023, deferred Item DM8.1 to the October 11, 12, and 13, 2023 meeting of City Council.
